name: lvx_label_create

ownership.argument: borrows a live LVGL parent object
ownership.return_value: returns a child label owned by the LVGL object tree

provenance.source: exact 3.101.043 IDB stock callsites sub_C4C3804 and sub_C56D5B0

notes: Stock callers pass a live parent in R0, call sub_C588F30, and retain returned R0 as the new label. The former corpus candidate sub_C588BF8 is instead called on an existing label with an integer property argument.
